- `distributed-inference-multi-node` is relevant if you ever pool VRAM across machines instead of a single bigger card.

- `qwen3-6-27b` — Qwen3.6-27B, 262K context, near-frontier coding, needs multi-GPU or quantization.

- `llm-compressor` — quantization toolkit (GPTQ/AWQ/FP8/etc.) for shrinking a model to fit a given card.
- `local-model-harness-patterns` — harness-level patterns (subagent delegation, loop detection) for running local models as coding agents.
- `parallel-local-inference` — running multiple concurrent agents on one GPU via vLLM.

The catalog has no 24GB- or 48GB-specific tutorial. Want me to file an intake item flagging that gap, or research one now?
